weakest_link: The rival field changes with the criterion. The odes to Whitman of §4.10 take him as a figure; the rivals now are works that make Whitman's solution to death scripture, or set him in a line of revelation.
disconfirmation_test: A work that makes the death-promise permanent as scripture continuous with the prior tradition, at equal or greater magnitude. Candidates to read, none yet seated or verified: Whitman's own notebook project of a 'New Bible' (c. 1857); R. M. Bucke, Cosmic Consciousness (1901); the Bolton Whitmanites' use of Leaves as a bible. The test that separates them: whether the scripture is a new American one or joins the prior chain.
